data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: review-complexity-classifier.sh reads review.size_upgrade_lines from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 300 when absent.
- DD2: review-complexity-classifier.sh reads review.size_warn_lines from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh, falling back to 600 when absent.

## Implementation

File: plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh

After the existing BEHAVIORAL_PATTERNS config read block (lines ~98-109), add:

```bash
# Read configurable size thresholds; fall back to defaults when absent
SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES=300
SIZE_WARN_LINES=600
if [[ -n "$READ_CONFIG" ]]; then
    _upgrade=$("$READ_CONFIG" review.size_upgrade_lines 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    _warn=$("$READ_CONFIG" review.size_warn_lines 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    [[ -n "$_upgrade" && "$_upgrade" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES="$_upgrade"
    [[ -n "$_warn" && "$_warn" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && SIZE_WARN_LINES="$_warn"
fi
```

In _compute_size_action(), replace hardcoded thresholds:
- Replace `(( diff_size_lines >= 600 ))` with `(( diff_size_lines >= SIZE_WARN_LINES ))`
- Replace `(( diff_size_lines >= 300 ))` with `(( diff_size_lines >= SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES ))`
- Update the SIZE_WARNING stderr message to use $SIZE_WARN_LINES instead of literal 600

Note: SIZE_UPGRADE_LINES and SIZE_WARN_LINES are script-level variables accessible inside _compute_size_action() — this mirrors how BEHAVIORAL_PATTERNS and BEHAVIORAL_COUNT are used across functions in this script.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL|Summary)"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && bash -c "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && bash -c "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_config_override passes (GREEN — threshold now config-driven)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep "test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_config_override.*PASS"
- [ ] test_classifier_size_warn_lines_config_override passes
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep "test_classifier_size_warn_lines_config_override.*PASS"
- [ ] test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_default_fallback passes
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep "test_classifier_size_upgrade_lines_default_fallback.*PASS"
- [ ] test_classifier_size_warn_lines_default_fallback passes
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep "test_classifier_size_warn_lines_default_fallback.*PASS"
- [ ] Existing size threshold tests (hardcoded 300/600 boundary tests) still pass — fallback defaults preserve behavior
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-review-complexity-classifier.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "test_classifier_size_action_(none_below_300|upgrade_at_300|warn_at_600|upgrade_at_599).*PASS"
- [ ] SIZE_WARN_LINES variable used in stderr SIZE_WARNING message (not hardcoded literal)
  Verify: grep "_compute_size_action" plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh | grep -v "SIZE_WARN_LINES" | grep -qv "600" || true; grep "SIZE_WARNING.*SIZE_WARN_LINES" plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement config-driven size thresholds in review-complexity-classifier.sh
